author: ETA PRIME
description:
Recently I got my hands on the brand-new MacBook Neo. Coming in at just $599 (or $499 for students), it’s powered by the Apple A18 Pro chip—and I had to see what this thing could do with emulation. In this video, we are testing everything from low-end retro consoles using OpenEmu all the way up to Gamecube, Wii, PS2, Wii U, and even PS3! The performance out of this 6-Core CPU / 5-Core GPU setup is actually pretty mind-blowing for a fanless, ultra-light machine.
